notes.policy: R22 (docs/performance.md): caps only move down. After a configured build of the integrated tree, each cap with room drops to min(cap, measured + max(ceil(1% of measured), 256)). A cap rises only with a reason recorded here: the release, the measured value, what grew and why that growth is accepted; it then rises to measured + the same margin, no further. pwaCoreBytes and pwaCoreFiles are the offline worker's install limits (PWA_BUDGET in src/pwa/worker.ts) and change only with them.

notes.compression: gzip level 9, independently per file, summed after deduplication. Fonts, JSON and the root worker are not part of the eager JS+CSS gate.
notes.lazy: All emitted assets/*.js outside the eager set; raw and gzip maxima are measured separately. The root service worker is excluded.
notes.routes: Whole-route cost: for each lazily loaded page or picker root (ROUTE_ROOTS in scripts/check-budgets.ts, every React.lazy() in src), the gzip9 bytes, per file, of its root chunk, its static-import closure and the CSS those chunks import, beyond the eager set, from the retained Vite manifest. The most expensive route is gated; every route is reported.
notes.cssScopes: App CSS is Vite-emitted assets/*.css. Standalone pwa/*.css may only be linked from pwa/offline.html or index.html noscript, never an app chunk or CSS import, and must be in the bounded PWA core. Active inline styles count in the gated index.html raw/gzip measurements, and the first-paint style in its own cap, rather than being silently added to or removed from the emitted-CSS baseline series.
